## Batch 2079, round r01 — review complete

I independently reviewed all 13 requested slugs by opening each native 1254px PNG plus a 200px downscale and targeted anatomy crops (counting heads/eyes/limbs/wings/hooves/fingers), comparing against each receipt's `visual_requirements` and the embedded ledger research claims. Every PNG's SHA‑256 was recomputed and matched against both the receipt and the Codex root native‑review hash before I wrote any decision.

**Result: 13 reviewed → 13 pass, 0 reject.**

**What was written (Claude fields only):**
- Each of the 13 receipts: added `root_visual_review` (reviewer `claude`, verdict `pass`, exact `native_sha256`, real time `2026-10-16T12:52:29+07:00`, specific notes) and set `status: reviewed`. Codex's `visual_review` left intact.
- Ledger `data/artwork-batch-2079.json`: synced those 13 items to `status: reviewed` (other 37 items untouched).
- Structured report: **`data/artwork-generated/session-2000-2026-10-16/claude-review-2079-r01.json`** (slug/hash/verdict/reason + totals).

I did not modify any PNG, Codex review, research/power, or manifest, and did not integrate, commit, or push. Note: the Codex native‑reviews file grew from 13→21 entries during my run (concurrent Codex work on out‑of‑scope slugs) — I left it untouched and re‑confirmed my 13 hashes still match it.
